svg.title: Selection: one target, distinct states
svg.desc: Original schematic crops. Markers keep capsule footprints; labels and dark keylines preserve their meaning without colour.

g.text: Original schematic crops. Markers keep capsule footprints; labels and dark keylines preserve their meaning without colour.
SIX A-04 FLOORS / FLAT SWATCHES, NOT A LIGHTING SIMULATION
Amber core on dark keyline: 10.41:1 in token space. Every floor still needs rendered pixel checks.
F / Right-stick press clears. Q / L shoulder previous. Tab / R shoulder next. No through-wall markers.
